dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are these tea leaves very valuable?

dialogues.speaker: Xing Cheng
dialogues.text: These are all the finest teas from Qiaoying Village! Whether in terms of ingredients or processing, they simply can't be beat!

dialogues.speaker: Xing Cheng
dialogues.text: I really can't be bothered to argue with that ignorant fool.

dialogues.speaker: Xing Cheng
dialogues.text: Let's not talk about it for now. I'll have to reason with her later.
